vBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2310: read-door done→merged reconciliation so closed/done issues never render mergeStatus=pending

plan.title: bug(read-model): closed/done issues render mergeStatus=pending — add read-door done→merged reconciliation
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: Closed/done issues render 'Done' in the project issue tree but 'pending' in the issue detail/slide-out. Root cause (verified): IssueDataService.getIssues() at src/dashboard/server/services/issue-data-service.ts:449-469 augments mergeStatus from an in-memory reviewStatusesCache that is currently empty (0 rows). When the cache misses, the issue passes through unchanged carrying its stale mergeStatus=pending (frozen from the per-issue record's planning-time pipeline block). The read door reconciles the forward direction (mergeStatus=merged but not yet done → show Verifying) but has no inverse: a done/closed issue carrying a non-merged mergeStatus is served unchanged. The tree renders canonical state (fresh → Done) while the issue display renders the stale mergeStatus (pending).
narratives.Proposal: Add inverse reconciliation inside the same .map() at issue-data-service.ts:449, applied regardless of cache state so it also fixes the empty-cache path. Compute canonical status once at the top of the callback via getCanonicalStatus(issue.state ?? issue.canonicalStatus ?? issue.status, issue.stateType) — the same precedence the forward branch already uses. When canonical status === 'done' and the issue carries a present, non-'merged' mergeStatus, coerce it to 'merged' before returning, in both the cache-hit and cache-miss return paths. Gate strictly on 'done' so 'canceled' issues (which getCanonicalStatus maps distinctly) are never shown as merged. Never invent a mergeStatus on an issue that had none, and never rewrite an already-merged value. Defense-in-depth: even with an empty cache or a stale record, a done issue never displays mergeStatus=pending.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing the upstream cause of the stale per-issue record or the empty review_status table (filed separately as the record-reconciliation bug)
- Backfilling or repairing the review_status SQLite table or the 18 already-affected records at rest
- Any change to the tree renderer or issue-display frontend components — the fix is entirely in the read-door resolver
- Changing forward reconciliation (merged-but-not-done → Verifying) behavior
- Coercing or otherwise altering the display of 'canceled' issues

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the inverse rule strictly on canonical status === 'done', not 'done' || 'canceled'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue explicitly requires that a canceled issue may legitimately be unmerged and must NOT be shown as merged. getCanonicalStatus already maps cancel-family statuses to 'canceled', distinct from 'done', so strict equality is correct and sufficient.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply the fix inside the existing .map() at line 449 rather than adding a new pass or helper module.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the inverse rule co-located with the forward rule it mirrors, avoids a second O(n) traversal of allIssues on a dashboard hot path, and matches the surgical-change convention. Reuses the existing getCanonicalStatus(state ?? canonicalStatus ?? status, stateType) precedence for consistency between the two directions.

autoDecisions.summary: Only rewrite a present, non-terminal mergeStatus; never synthesize one and never touch an already-merged value.
autoDecisions.rationale: Guarding on issue.mergeStatus && issue.mergeStatus !== 'merged' avoids inventing state on issues that never carried a mergeStatus and keeps the transform idempotent.

autoDecisions.summary: Deliver the fix and its regression test as a single bead.
autoDecisions.rationale: This is a ~6-line single-file bug fix whose regression test is its proof (write-the-test-then-make-it-pass). Splitting them would leave a fix bead without a test and a test bead that cannot land before it, violating independent-mergeability. The change is one indivisible vertical slice.

items.title: Add done→merged inverse reconciliation to IssueDataService.getIssues() and cover it with a regression test

expected_outputs: tests/dashboard/issue-data-service.test.ts passes including the new done→merged and canceled-unaffected cases

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/server/services/issue-data-service.ts, edit the .map() callback that starts at line 450 ('Augment with mergeStatus from the asynchronous review-status cache.'). (1) Move the canonical-status computation to the top of the callback so it is available on every path: `const canonical = getCanonicalStatus(issue.state ?? issue.canonicalStatus ?? issue.status, issue.stateType);` and reuse it in the existing forward branch (replace the inner recomputation at the current line 456). (2) In the cache-hit path, before `return issueWithMerge;`, add: if `canonical === 'done' && issueWithMerge.mergeStatus !== 'merged'`, return `{ ...issueWithMerge, mergeStatus: 'merged' }`. (3) In the cache-miss path, before the final `return issue;`, add: if `canonical === 'done' && issue.mergeStatus && issue.mergeStatus !== 'merged'`, return `{ ...issue, mergeStatus: 'merged' }`. Do NOT include 'canceled' in either check. Then add two unit tests to tests/dashboard/issue-data-service.test.ts, next to the existing 'should restore verifying state for reopened issues with merged review status' test (~line 221), using the same injectIssues + service.reviewStatusesCache harness: (a) an issue with state='done'/status='Done' and mergeStatus='pending', empty reviewStatusesCache, asserts result mergeStatus==='merged'; (b) an issue with status='Canceled' and mergeStatus='pending', empty reviewStatusesCache, asserts result mergeStatus==='pending'. Use cycle:'all' so done/canceled issues are not filtered out.

items.title: getIssues() resolves a done issue's non-merged mergeStatus to 'merged' when the review-status cache is empty (given state=done, empty cache, mergeStatus=pending → returns mergeStatus=merged)
getIssues() preserves a canceled issue's mergeStatus unchanged (given status=Canceled, empty cache, mergeStatus=pending → returns mergeStatus=pending, never merged)
getIssues() never synthesizes a mergeStatus: a done issue with no mergeStatus and empty cache returns output with mergeStatus still absent/undefined
tests/dashboard/issue-data-service.test.ts passes and npm run typecheck completes without errors after the change
